mechanism: Metoclopramide increases gastric motility and accelerates gastric emptying, which may reduce minocycline absorption in the stomach; minocycline can cause esophageal irritation and metoclopramide may paradoxically increase contact time in some scenarios.
action: Separate administration by 2-3 hours; monitor for reduced minocycline efficacy and consider alternative antiemetic if prolonged minocycline therapy required.
